jobTitle: Engineering Precision | Logistics Excellence | MBA in Progress
tagline: Innovating Across Fields. Delivering Beyond Expectations.
shortBio: Mechanical Engineering graduate and logistics professional with hands-on experience in warehouse operations, SAP, WMS, inventory management, receiving, and shipping. Currently pursuing an MBA to strengthen my management and business expertise.
longAboutMe:
Hi, I'm Anandhu Jayan, a Mechanical Engineering graduate currently working in logistics and warehouse operations in Saudi Arabia. My professional experience includes SAP and WMS operations, receiving and GRN, inventory management, order processing, shipping, invoicing, and warehouse documentation.

Alongside my professional career, I am currently pursuing an MBA to strengthen my understanding of management, business, and organizational operations. My interests extend beyond logistics and supply chain into technology, entrepreneurship, and digital transformation.

I am also exploring the startup ecosystem and currently working on an early-stage SaaS product inspired by real-world operational challenges. Through this journey, I am gaining hands-on exposure to product development, business strategy, and building technology-driven solutions that simplify complex workflows.

I am particularly interested in the intersection of operations, technology, and business, with a long-term goal of creating practical digital products and building ventures that solve meaningful real-world problems.
